shadow.$description: Drop shadows. xs to lg are the Preline effect styles the final screens use (Drop Shadow/sm, /default, /md, /lg); the rest are the file's own effects.

sm.$description: Preline Drop Shadow/default: primary buttons, tables.

lg.$description: Preline Drop Shadow/lg: dropdowns, slider tooltips.

menu.$description: The Admin's open Filter menu: black 7%, 8 px down, 16 px blur (Figma also shifts it 3 px left; centred here). Only a menu's first level has it.

refusal.$description: The red glow of a refused move (today's energy pill: a 2 px red ring at 55% and this 16 px glow at 35%; the ring is drawn with ring-danger/50).

thumb.$description: Preline 'Input / Range Slider Touch Area': the slider thumb.

modal.$description: The drop parts of the Figma modal glass stack.

button.$description: Solid buttons (btnPublish): the outer half of the centred 12% black stroke as a 1 px ring, over Preline's default drop shadow.

drop-shadow.$description: Shadows that follow the shape of the content (CSS drop-shadow filters), as Figma draws the effect of a frame without a fill.

glow.$description: The cyan glow around a solid button's label (btnPublish 'Btn/large': 0 2 10 at 8%).

glow-strong.$description: The same glow while the button is loading or has succeeded (50%).

glass.$description: CSS approximation of the Figma 'Glass Shadow' effect style (six inner shadows with blend modes CSS box-shadow cannot express): a soft white inner glow and 1 px light rims. Used by the resource chips and the round counter.

kpi-bar.$description: The player KPI bar's Glass Shadow (Navbar Variant2), its two soft layers as today's KPI bar draws them: a gray inner glow and a white inner haze. The file's light and dark 1 px rims use blend modes box-shadow cannot express.

button.$description: Solid buttons: the inner half of the centred 12% black stroke.

blur.$description: Blur radii for backdrop and layer blurs.

glow.$description: Glow blobs behind the primary button.

overlay.$description: The modal and drawer scrim. Figma's Background Blur 40 renders like a 16 to 17 px CSS blur (fitted on three dialog frames); a 40 px CSS blur would be over twice as strong.
